name: argument-parser-positive-test-e41e5b8a0a/float-05-v
reason: The function signature is supported, but the essential behavior is entry-point command-line conversion of the string -0x1efa2p1 to a float. subset10 does not cover command-line argument parsing or main-entry argument conversion. Numeric-literal support does not establish support for parsing an external argument string, so the complete case is not supported by this specification.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line argument binding/conversion to main(float f), specifically a negative hexadecimal floating-point argument
test_design_notes: The @args marker supplies an external string, not a Ballerina numeric literal.
The @output marker expects -253764.0; io:println is output instrumentation and is not the basis of the feature classification.
